front_question: Define the discriminant D of a quadratic equation ax^2 + bx + c = 0 and state how it determines the nature of roots.
back_answer:
Discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac.
1) If D > 0: two distinct real roots.
2) If D = 0: two equal real roots.
3) If D < 0: no real roots.

front_question: A motorboat whose speed is 18 km/h in still water takes 1 hour more to go 24 km upstream than downstream. Write the quadratic equation governing the stream speed x.
back_answer: Upstream speed = 18 - x, downstream speed = 18 + x. Time equation: 24/(18-x) - 24/(18+x) = 1 => 48x = 324 - x^2 => x^2 + 48x - 324 = 0.
